pairs.registryProposal: Technique-shaped resonance worth noting: this context is not a repo checker but the re-measurement loop downstream of one (it consumes the standards scan and stamps cleared/regressed). The failure-not-empty-success rule bit exactly at the consumer boundary, where a checker's read error becomes an empty result set. claim-write-back could name 'the consumer of a checker's output must distinguish an empty result from a failed read' as an explicit decision rule.
